pairing.title: Create HomeKit Plus
pairing.description: Submit to create {name}. Pair it from the HomeKit Plus Pairing notification. Selected entities that need accessory mode have separate pairing notifications.

user.title: Select entities for HomeKit Plus
user.description: Search by entity name or entity ID and select the entities to expose in Apple Home. Only selected entities are included. An empty selection exposes nothing. Cameras, locks, TVs and activity remotes that require accessory mode get their own pairing entry.

reconfigure.title: Manage bridged devices
reconfigure.description: Manage entities in this bridge. Remove a selected item with its × button, or search and select another entity to add it. Submit to update the existing bridge.

error.invalid_entities: Selected entities are unavailable or unsupported.
error.one_entity_required: Accessory mode requires exactly one entity.

data.camera_copy: Cameras that support native H.264 streams

cameras.description: Check all cameras that support native H.264 streams. If the camera does not output a H.264 stream, the system will transcode the video to H.264 for HomeKit. Transcoding requires a performant CPU and is unlikely to work on single-board computers.
cameras.title: Camera configuration

climate.description: Choose which accessory each climate entity uses in HomeKit. Heater Cooler puts the mode, temperature, and the supported fan speed and swing controls on one air conditioner style tile; Thermostat is the classic temperature dial with a separate fan. Automatic keeps the accessory the entity already uses and picks the best fit when it is bridged for the first time. Changing the accessory type keeps the room and name, but HomeKit scenes or automations that used the old controls may need to be recreated.
climate.title: Climate accessory configuration

unpair.description: Forcefully removes all pairings from an accessory to allow re-pairing. Use this action if the accessory is no longer responsive and you want to avoid deleting and re-adding the entry. Room locations and accessory preferences will be lost.
unpair.name: Unpair an accessory or bridge
